description: This file contains utility classes and constants for interacting with Azure Table storage in an Orleans project. It defines methods for handling exceptions, validating table names, sanitizing keys, and constructing queries specific to Azure Table storage operations. It also includes conditional namespace definitions based on compile-time flags.

classes.name: AzureTableConstants
classes.description: Contains constants related to Azure Table storage, such as maximum batch size and property names.

classes.name: AzureTableUtils
classes.description: Provides utility methods for handling exceptions, validating table names, sanitizing keys, and forming queries for Azure Table storage operations.

methods.name: TableStorageDataNotFound
methods.description: Inspects an exception to determine if it indicates data was not found in Azure Table storage.

methods.name: ExtractRestErrorCode
methods.description: Extracts the REST error code from an exception, if available.

methods.name: EvaluateException
methods.description: Analyzes an exception to extract HTTP status and REST error codes, indicating if the exception relates to an Azure Table storage error.

methods.name: IsRetriableHttpError
methods.description: Determines if an HTTP status and REST error code combination represents a transient or retriable error.

methods.name: IsContentionError
methods.description: Checks whether an HTTP status code corresponds to a storage contention error.

methods.name: IsNotFoundError
methods.description: Checks if the HTTP status code indicates that the requested data was not found.

methods.name: ValidateTableName
methods.description: Validates that a table name conforms to Azure storage naming rules.

methods.name: SanitizeTableProperty
methods.description: Removes invalid characters from a string intended for use as a PartitionKey or RowKey.

methods.name: AnalyzeReadException
methods.description: Logs and determines if an exception encountered during a read operation is retriable.

methods.name: PrintStorageException
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing a RequestFailedException from Azure storage.

methods.name: PointQuery
methods.description: Constructs a filter query for a point lookup using PartitionKey and RowKey.

methods.name: RangeQuery
methods.description: Constructs a filter query for a range of RowKeys within a PartitionKey.
